rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition on raw counts fits the unpaired 6v6 single-batch design, and the shallow sample is retained in the primary run with a stated sensitivity exclusion, library sizes, size factors, and PCA distance to the group centroid (no sample distance heatmap is mentioned). Normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model, apeglm shrinkage precedes ranking, and padj<0.05 is the stated cutoff, but no low-count filter is specified anywhere. Enrichment correctly uses the species-matched mouse Hallmark (MH) collection with version and a symbol match-rate check, runs fgsea on the full ranked list with the metric stated, yet omits the set-size window and does not state the ORA universe; ranking on padj with p as fallback is also an awkward mixed metric. The report covers design, thresholds, and power/shallow-sample caveats but does not commit to package versions or explicit tested/significant gene counts.
